### `backend/src/test/java/com/sportconnect/security/JwtServiceTest.java`

```java
package com.sportconnect.security;

import io.jsonwebtoken.Claims;
import io.jsonwebtoken.ExpiredJwtException;
import io.jsonwebtoken.JwtException;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatCode;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

class JwtServiceTest {

    private static final String LONG_SECRET =
            "this-is-a-sufficiently-long-secret-key-for-hs256-tests";

    @Test
    void generateToken_and_parseToken_roundTrip() {
        JwtService jwtService = new JwtService(LONG_SECRET, 3600);
        String token = jwtService.generateToken("user-123", "user@example.com");

        Claims claims = jwtService.parseToken(token);

        assertThat(claims.getSubject()).isEqualTo("user-123");
        assertThat(claims.get("email", String.class)).isEqualTo("user@example.com");
        assertThat(claims.getExpiration()).isAfter(claims.getIssuedAt());
    }

    @Test
    void constructor_padsShortSecretsWithoutThrowing() {
        assertThatCode(() -> new JwtService("short-secret", 3600))
                .doesNotThrowAnyException();
    }

    @Test
    void parseToken_expiredToken_throwsExpiredJwtException() {
        JwtService jwtService = new JwtService(LONG_SECRET, -1); // already expired
        String token = jwtService.generateToken("user-123", "user@example.com");

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> jwtService.parseToken(token))
                .isInstanceOf(ExpiredJwtException.class);
    }

    @Test
    void parseToken_tamperedToken_throwsJwtException() {
        JwtService jwtService = new JwtService(LONG_SECRET, 3600);
        String token = jwtService.generateToken("user-123", "user@example.com");
        String tampered = token.substring(0, token.length() - 2) + "xx";

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> jwtService.parseToken(tampered))
                .isInstanceOf(JwtException.class);
    }

    @Test
    void getExpirationSeconds_returnsConfiguredValue() {
        JwtService jwtService = new JwtService(LONG_SECRET, 7200);
        assertThat(jwtService.getExpirationSeconds()).isEqualTo(7200);
    }
}
```

### `backend/src/test/java/com/sportconnect/service/AuthServiceTest.java`

```java
package com.sportconnect.service;

import com.sportconnect.dto.auth.LoginRequest;
import com.sportconnect.dto.auth.LoginResponse;
import com.sportconnect.dto.auth.RegisterRequest;
import com.sportconnect.dto.auth.RegisterResponse;
import com.sportconnect.exception.ConflictException;
import com.sportconnect.exception.UnauthorizedException;
import com.sportconnect.model.User;
import com.sportconnect.repository.UserRepository;
import com.sportconnect.security.JwtService;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.mockito.ArgumentCaptor;
import org.mockito.InjectMocks;
import org.mockito.Mock;
import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension;
import org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder;

import java.util.Optional;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.any;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.anyString;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.*;

@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)
class AuthServiceTest {

    @Mock private UserRepository userRepository;
    @Mock private PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder;
    @Mock private JwtService jwtService;

    @InjectMocks private AuthService authService;

    @Test
    void register_newEmail_savesUserWithHashedPasswordAndNormalizedEmail() {
        RegisterRequest req = new RegisterRequest();
        req.setEmail("  User@Example.com ");
        req.setPassword("plaintext123");
        req.setDisplayName("User One");

        when(userRepository.existsByEmail("user@example.com")).thenReturn(false);
        when(passwordEncoder.encode("plaintext123")).thenReturn("hashed");
        when(userRepository.save(any(User.class))).thenAnswer(inv -> {
            User u = inv.getArgument(0);
            u.setId("generated-id");
            return u;
        });

        RegisterResponse response = authService.register(req);

        ArgumentCaptor<User> captor = ArgumentCaptor.forClass(User.class);
        verify(userRepository).save(captor.capture());
        User saved = captor.getValue();

        assertThat(saved.getEmail()).isEqualTo("user@example.com");
        assertThat(saved.getPasswordHash()).isEqualTo("hashed");
        assertThat(response.getId()).isEqualTo("generated-id");
        assertThat(response.getEmail()).isEqualTo("user@example.com");
    }

    @Test
    void register_existingEmail_throwsConflict() {
        RegisterRequest req = new RegisterRequest();
        req.setEmail("dup@example.com");
        req.setPassword("password123");
        req.setDisplayName("Dup");

        when(userRepository.existsByEmail("dup@example.com")).thenReturn(true);

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> authService.register(req)).isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class);
        verify(userRepository, never()).save(any());
    }

    @Test
    void login_validCredentials_returnsTokenAndSummary() {
        LoginRequest req = new LoginRequest();
        req.setEmail("user@example.com");
        req.setPassword("password123");

        User user = new User();
        user.setId("u1");
        user.setEmail("user@example.com");
        user.setPasswordHash("hashed");
        user.setDisplayName("User One");

        when(userRepository.findByEmail("user@example.com")).thenReturn(Optional.of(user));
        when(passwordEncoder.matches("password123", "hashed")).thenReturn(true);
        when(jwtService.generateToken("u1", "user@example.com")).thenReturn("jwt-token");
        when(jwtService.getExpirationSeconds()).thenReturn(3600L);

        LoginResponse response = authService.login(req);

        assertThat(response.getAccessToken()).isEqualTo("jwt-token");
        assertThat(response.getExpiresIn()).isEqualTo(3600L);
        assertThat(response.getUser().getId()).isEqualTo("u1");
    }

    @Test
    void login_unknownEmail_throwsUnauthorized() {
        LoginRequest req = new LoginRequest();
        req.setEmail("missing@example.com");
        req.setPassword("password123");

        when(userRepository.findByEmail("missing@example.com")).thenReturn(Optional.empty());

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> authService.login(req)).isInstanceOf(UnauthorizedException.class);
    }

    @Test
    void login_wrongPassword_throwsUnauthorized() {
        LoginRequest req = new LoginRequest();
        req.setEmail("user@example.com");
        req.setPassword("wrongpass");

        User user = new User();
        user.setEmail("user@example.com");
        user.setPasswordHash("hashed");

        when(userRepository.findByEmail("user@example.com")).thenReturn(Optional.of(user));
        when(passwordEncoder.matches("wrongpass", "hashed")).thenReturn(false);

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> authService.login(req)).isInstanceOf(UnauthorizedException.class);
        verify(jwtService, never()).generateToken(anyString(), anyString());
    }
}
```

### `backend/src/test/java/com/sportconnect/service/EventServiceTest.java`

```java
package com.sportconnect.service;

import com.sportconnect.dto.event.EventCreateRequest;
import com.sportconnect.dto.event.EventDTO;
import com.sportconnect.dto.event.EventUpdateRequest;
import com.sportconnect.dto.event.LocationDTO;
import com.sportconnect.exception.BadRequestException;
import com.sportconnect.exception.ConflictException;
import com.sportconnect.exception.ForbiddenException;
import com.sportconnect.exception.ResourceNotFoundException;
import com.sportconnect.model.Event;
import com.sportconnect.model.EventStatus;
import com.sportconnect.model.SportType;
import com.sportconnect.repository.EventRepository;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.mockito.Mock;
import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.MongoTemplate;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.geo.GeoJsonPoint;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.any;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.*;

@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)
class EventServiceTest {

    @Mock private EventRepository eventRepository;
    @Mock private MongoTemplate mongoTemplate;
    @Mock private NotificationService notificationService;

    private final EventMapper eventMapper = new EventMapper();
    private EventService eventService;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        eventService = new EventService(eventRepository, mongoTemplate, notificationService, eventMapper);
    }

    private Event buildEvent(String organizerId, int max, List<String> participants, EventStatus status) {
        Event event = new Event();
        event.setId("event-1");
        event.setSportType(SportType.FOOTBALL);
        event.setTitle("Sunday match");
        event.setDescription("Friendly game");
        event.setLocation(new GeoJsonPoint(2.35, 48.85));
        event.setAddressLabel("Paris");
        event.setStartTime(Instant.now().plusSeconds(3600));
        event.setDurationMinutes(60);
        event.setMaxParticipants(max);
        event.setParticipantIds(new ArrayList<>(participants));
        event.setOrganizerId(organizerId);
        event.setStatus(status);
        event.setReminderSent(false);
        event.setCreatedAt(Instant.now());
        event.setUpdatedAt(Instant.now());
        return event;
    }

    private EventCreateRequest buildCreateRequest() {
        EventCreateRequest req = new EventCreateRequest();
        req.setSportType(SportType.FOOTBALL);
        req.setTitle("Sunday match");
        req.setDescription("Friendly game");
        req.setLocation(new LocationDTO(48.85, 2.35));
        req.setAddressLabel("Paris");
        req.setStartTime(Instant.now().plusSeconds(3600));
        req.setDurationMinutes(60);
        req.setMaxParticipants(4);
        return req;
    }

    @Test
    void createEvent_savesEventAsOpen_andNotifiesNewGame() {
        when(eventRepository.save(any(Event.class))).thenAnswer(inv -> {
            Event e = inv.getArgument(0);
            e.setId("event-1");
            return e;
        });

        EventDTO dto = eventService.createEvent("organizer-1", buildCreateRequest());

        assertThat(dto.getStatus()).isEqualTo("OPEN");
        assertThat(dto.isOwnedByCurrentUser()).isTrue();
        assertThat(dto.getOrganizerId()).isEqualTo("organizer-1");
        verify(notificationService).notifyNewGame(any(Event.class));
    }

    @Test
    void joinEvent_addsParticipant_whenOpenAndNotFull() {
        Event event = buildEvent("organizer-1", 2, new ArrayList<>(), EventStatus.OPEN);
        when(eventRepository.findById("event-1")).thenReturn(Optional.of(event));
        when(eventRepository.save(any(Event.class))).thenAnswer(inv -> inv.getArgument(0));

        EventDTO dto = eventService.joinEvent("event-1", "user-2");

        assertThat(dto.getCurrentParticipants()).isEqualTo(1);
        assertThat(dto.isJoinedByCurrentUser()).isTrue();
        assertThat(dto.getStatus()).isEqualTo("OPEN");
        verify(notificationService).notifyRosterChange(any(Event.class));
    }

    @Test
    void joinEvent_marksFull_whenLastSpotTaken() {
        Event event = buildEvent("organizer-1", 1, new ArrayList<>(), EventStatus.OPEN);
        when(eventRepository.findById("event-1")).thenReturn(Optional.of(event));
        when(eventRepository.save(any(Event.class))).thenAnswer(inv -> inv.getArgument(0));

        EventDTO dto = eventService.joinEvent("event-1", "user-2");

        assertThat(dto.getStatus()).isEqualTo("FULL");
    }

    @Test
    void joinEvent_alreadyJoined_throwsConflict() {
        Event event = buildEvent("organizer-1", 5, List.of("user-2"), EventStatus.OPEN);
        when(eventRepository.findById("event-1")).thenReturn(Optional.of(event));

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> eventService.joinEvent("event-1", "user-2"))
                .isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class);
    }

    @Test
    void joinEvent_full_throwsConflict() {
        Event event = buildEvent("organizer-1", 1, List.of("user-3"), EventStatus.FULL);
        when(eventRepository.findById("event-1")).thenReturn(Optional.of(event));

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> eventService.joinEvent("event-1", "user-2"))
                .isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class);
    }

    @Test
    void joinEvent_cancelledEvent_throwsConflict() {
        Event event = buildEvent("organizer-1", 5, new ArrayList<>(), EventStatus.CANCELLED);
        when(eventRepository.findById("event-1")).thenReturn(Optional.of(event));

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> eventService.joinEvent("event-1", "user-2"))
                .isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class);
    }

    @Test
    void joinEvent_notFound_throwsResourceNotFound() {
        when(eventRepository.findById("missing")).thenReturn(Optional.empty());

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> eventService.joinEvent("missing", "user-2"))
                .isInstanceOf(ResourceNotFoundException.class);
    }

    @Test
    void leaveEvent_removesParticipant_andReopensFullEvent() {
        Event event = buildEvent("organizer-1", 1, List.of("user-2"), EventStatus.FULL);
        when(eventRepository.findById("event-1")).thenReturn(Optional.of(event));
        when(eventRepository.save(any(Event.class))).thenAnswer(inv -> inv.getArgument(0));

        EventDTO dto = eventService.leaveEvent("event-1", "user-2");

        assertThat(dto.getCurrentParticipants()).isEqualTo(0);
        assertThat(dto.getStatus()).isEqualTo("OPEN");
        verify(notificationService).notifyRosterChange(any(Event.class));
    }

    @Test
    void leaveEvent_notAParticipant_throwsBadRequest() {
        Event event = buildEvent("organizer-1", 5, new ArrayList<>(), EventStatus.OPEN);
        when(eventRepository.findById("event-1")).thenReturn(Optional.of(event));

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> eventService.leaveEvent("event-1", "user-2"))
                .isInstanceOf(BadRequestException.class);
    }

    @Test
    void updateEvent_byNonOwner_throwsForbidden() {
        Event event = buildEvent("organizer-1", 5, new ArrayList<>(), EventStatus.OPEN);
        when(eventRepository.findById("event-1")).thenReturn(Optional.of(event));

        EventUpdateRequest req = new EventUpdateRequest();
        req.setSportType(SportType.TENNIS);
        req.setTitle("Updated");
        req.setLocation(new LocationDTO(1.0, 1.0));
        req.setAddressLabel("Somewhere");
        req.setStartTime(Instant.now().plusSeconds(1000));
        req.setDurationMinutes(30);
        req.setMaxParticipants(2);

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> eventService.updateEvent("event-1", "intruder", req))
                .isInstanceOf(ForbiddenException.class);
        verify(eventRepository, never()).save(any());
    }

    @Test
    void updateEvent_byOwner_updatesFields() {
        Event event = buildEvent("organizer-1", 5, new ArrayList<>(), EventStatus.OPEN);
        when(eventRepository.findById("event-1")).thenReturn(Optional.of(event));
        when(eventRepository.save(any(Event.class))).thenAnswer(inv -> inv.getArgument(0));

        EventUpdateRequest req = new EventUpdateRequest();
        req.setSportType(SportType.TENNIS);
        req.setTitle("Updated title");
        req.setDescription("New description");
        req.setLocation(new LocationDTO(10.0, 20.0));
        req.setAddressLabel("New place");
        req.setStartTime(Instant.now().plusSeconds(5000));
        req.setDurationMinutes(90);
        req.setMaxParticipants(8);

        EventDTO dto = eventService.updateEvent("event-1", "organizer-1", req);

        assertThat(dto.getTitle()).isEqualTo("Updated title");
        assertThat(dto.getSportType()).isEqualTo("TENNIS");
        assertThat(dto.getMaxParticipants()).isEqualTo(8);
    }

    @Test
    void cancelEvent_byOwner_setsCancelledAndNotifies() {
        Event event = buildEvent("organizer-1", 5, List.of("user-2"), EventStatus.OPEN);
        when(eventRepository.findById("event-1")).thenReturn(Optional.of(event));
        when(eventRepository.save(any(Event.class))).thenAnswer(inv -> inv.getArgument(0));

        eventService.cancelEvent("event-1", "organizer-1");

        assertThat(event.getStatus()).isEqualTo(EventStatus.CANCELLED);
        verify(notificationService).notifyEventCancelled(event);
    }

    @Test
    void cancelEvent_byNonOwner_throwsForbidden() {
        Event event = buildEvent("organizer-1", 5, new ArrayList<>(), EventStatus.OPEN);
        when(eventRepository.findById("event-1")).thenReturn(Optional.of(event));

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> eventService.cancelEvent("event-1", "intruder"))
                .isInstanceOf(ForbiddenException.class);
    }

    @Test
    void listEvents_negativeRadius_throwsBadRequest() {
        assertThatThrownBy(() ->
                eventService.listEvents(null, null, null, 48.85, 2.35, -5.0, "user-1"))
                .isInstanceOf(BadRequestException.class);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.sportconnect.service;

import com.sportconnect.dto.event.LocationDTO;
import com.sportconnect.dto.user.UpdateProfileRequest;
import com.sportconnect.dto.user.UserDTO;
import com.sportconnect.exception.ResourceNotFoundException;
import com.sportconnect.model.Event;
import com.sportconnect.model.EventStatus;
import com.sportconnect.model.SportType;
import com.sportconnect.model.User;
import com.sportconnect.repository.EventRepository;
import com.sportconnect.repository.UserRepository;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.mockito.Mock;
import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.geo.GeoJsonPoint;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.any;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.when;

@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)
class UserServiceTest {

    @Mock private UserRepository userRepository;
    @Mock private EventRepository eventRepository;
    private final EventMapper eventMapper = new EventMapper();

    private UserService userService;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        userService = new UserService(userRepository, eventRepository, eventMapper);
    }

    @Test
    void getCurrentUser_notFound_throws() {
        when(userRepository.findById("missing")).thenReturn(Optional.empty());
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> userService.getCurrentUser("missing"))
                .isInstanceOf(ResourceNotFoundException.class);
    }

    @Test
    void updateProfile_onlyDisplayName_leavesOtherFieldsUnchanged() {
        User user = new User();
        user.setId("u1");
        user.setEmail("u1@example.com");
        user.setDisplayName("Old Name");
        user.setPreferredSports(List.of("FOOTBALL"));

        when(userRepository.findById("u1")).thenReturn(Optional.of(user));
        when(userRepository.save(any(User.class))).thenAnswer(inv -> inv.getArgument(0));

        UpdateProfileRequest req = new UpdateProfileRequest();
        req.setDisplayName("New Name");

        UserDTO dto = userService.updateProfile("u1", req);

        assertThat(dto.getDisplayName()).isEqualTo("New Name");
        assertThat(dto.getPreferredSports()).containsExactly("FOOTBALL");
    }

    @Test
    void updateProfile_updatesPreferredSportsAndLocation() {
        User user = new User();
        user.setId("u1");
        user.setDisplayName("Name");
        user.setPreferredSports(List.of());

        when(userRepository.findById("u1")).thenReturn(Optional.of(user));
        when(userRepository.save(any(User.class))).thenAnswer(inv -> inv.getArgument(0));

        UpdateProfileRequest req = new UpdateProfileRequest();
        req.setPreferredSports(List.of(SportType.TENNIS, SportType.RUNNING));
        req.setHomeLocation(new LocationDTO(48.85, 2.35));

        UserDTO dto = userService.updateProfile("u1", req);

        assertThat(dto.getPreferredSports()).containsExactly("TENNIS", "RUNNING");
        assertThat(dto.getHomeLocation().getLat()).isEqualTo(48.85);
        assertThat(dto.getHomeLocation().getLng()).isEqualTo(2.35);
    }

    @Test
    void getOrganizedEvents_mapsEventsForOwner() {
        Event event = new Event();
        event.setId("e1");
        event.setSportType(SportType.FOOTBALL);
        event.setTitle("Game");
        event.setLocation(new GeoJsonPoint(2.0, 48.0));
        event.setAddressLabel("Paris");
        event.setStartTime(Instant.now());
        event.setDurationMinutes(60);
        event.setMaxParticipants(4);
        event.setParticipantIds(new ArrayList<>());
        event.setOrganizerId("u1");
        event.setStatus(EventStatus.OPEN);

        when(eventRepository.findByOrganizerId("u1")).thenReturn(List.of(event));

        var response = userService.getOrganizedEvents("u1");

        assertThat(response.getTotal()).isEqualTo(1);
        assertThat(response.getItems().get(0).isOwnedByCurrentUser()).isTrue();
    }
}
```

### `backend/src/test/java/com/sportconnect/service/NotificationServiceTest.java`

```java
package com.sportconnect.service;

import com.sportconnect.model.Event;
import com.sportconnect.model.EventStatus;
import com.sportconnect.model.SportType;
import com.sportconnect.model.User;
import com.sportconnect.repository.UserRepository;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.mockito.Mock;
import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.any;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.eq;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.never;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.verify;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.when;

@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)
class NotificationServiceTest {

    @Mock private SseEmitterRegistry registry;
    @Mock private UserRepository userRepository;

    private NotificationService notificationService;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        notificationService = new NotificationService(registry, userRepository);
    }

    private Event buildEvent() {
        Event event = new Event();
        event.setId("e1");
        event.setSportType(SportType.FOOTBALL);
        event.setTitle("Game");
        event.setOrganizerId("organizer-1");
        event.setParticipantIds(new ArrayList<>(List.of("p1", "p2")));
        event.setMaxParticipants(5);
        event.setStartTime(Instant.now().plusSeconds(600));
        event.setStatus(EventStatus.OPEN);
        return event;
    }

    @Test
    void notifyNewGame_notifiesInterestedUsers_excludingOrganizer() {
        User organizerAlsoInterested = new User();
        organizerAlsoInterested.setId("organizer-1");
        User interestedUser = new User();
        interestedUser.setId("fan-1");

        when(userRepository.findByPreferredSportsContaining("FOOTBALL"))
                .thenReturn(List.of(organizerAlsoInterested, interestedUser));

        notificationService.notifyNewGame(buildEvent());

        verify(registry).sendToUser(eq("fan-1"), eq("new-game"), any());
        verify(registry, never()).sendToUser(eq("organizer-1"), eq("new-game"), any());
    }

    @Test
    void notifyRosterChange_notifiesOrganizerAndAllParticipants() {
        notificationService.notifyRosterChange(buildEvent());

        verify(registry).sendToUser(eq("organizer-1"), eq("roster-change"), any());
        verify(registry).sendToUser(eq("p1"), eq("roster-change"), any());
        verify(registry).sendToUser(eq("p2"), eq("roster-change"), any());
    }

    @Test
    void notifyEventCancelled_notifiesOrganizerAndParticipants() {
        notificationService.notifyEventCancelled(buildEvent());

        verify(registry).sendToUser(eq("organizer-1"), eq("event-cancelled"), any());
        verify(registry).sendToUser(eq("p1"), eq("event-cancelled"), any());
        verify(registry).sendToUser(eq("p2"), eq("event-cancelled"), any());
    }
}
```

### `backend/src/test/java/com/sportconnect/controller/AuthControllerIntegrationTest.java`

```java
package com.sportconnect.controller;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.sportconnect.dto.auth.LoginRequest;
import com.sportconnect.dto.auth.RegisterRequest;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.autoconfigure.web.servlet.AutoConfigureMockMvc;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.test.context.DynamicPropertyRegistry;
import org.springframework.test.context.DynamicPropertySource;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.MockMvc;
import org.testcontainers.containers.MongoDBContainer;
import org.testcontainers.junit.jupiter.Container;
import org.testcontainers.junit.jupiter.Testcontainers;

import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.MockMvcRequestBuilders.post;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.result.MockMvcResultMatchers.*;

@Testcontainers
@SpringBootTest
@AutoConfigureMockMvc
class AuthControllerIntegrationTest {

    @Container
    static MongoDBContainer mongo = new MongoDBContainer("mongo:6.0");

    @DynamicPropertySource
    static void mongoProps(DynamicPropertyRegistry registry) {
        registry.add("spring.data.mongodb.uri", mongo::getReplicaSetUrl);
    }

    @Autowired private MockMvc mockMvc;
    @Autowired private ObjectMapper objectMapper;

    private RegisterRequest registerRequest(String email) {
        RegisterRequest req = new RegisterRequest();
        req.setEmail(email);
        req.setPassword("password123");
        req.setDisplayName("Test User");
        return req;
    }

    @Test
    void register_thenLogin_succeeds() throws Exception {
        RegisterRequest req = registerRequest("flow@example.com");

        mockMvc.perform(post("/api/auth/register")
                        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .content(objectMapper.writeValueAsString(req)))
                .andExpect(status().isCreated())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.email").value("flow@example.com"));

        LoginRequest login = new LoginRequest();
        login.setEmail("flow@example.com");
        login.setPassword("password123");

        mockMvc.perform(post("/api/auth/login")
                        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .content(objectMapper.writeValueAsString(login)))
                .andExpect(status().isOk())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.accessToken").isNotEmpty())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.user.email").value("flow@example.com"));
    }

    @Test
    void register_duplicateEmail_returns409() throws Exception {
        RegisterRequest req = registerRequest("dup@example.com");
        mockMvc.perform(post("/api/auth/register")
                        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .content(objectMapper.writeValueAsString(req)))
                .andExpect(status().isCreated());

        mockMvc.perform(post("/api/auth/register")
                        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .content(objectMapper.writeValueAsString(req)))
                .andExpect(status().isConflict())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.message").exists());
    }

    @Test
    void register_invalidEmail_returns400() throws Exception {
        RegisterRequest req = registerRequest("not-an-email");

        mockMvc.perform(post("/api/auth/register")
                        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .content(objectMapper.writeValueAsString(req)))
                .andExpect(status().isBadRequest());
    }

    @Test
    void login_wrongPassword_returns401() throws Exception {
        RegisterRequest req = registerRequest("wrongpass@example.com");
        mockMvc.perform(post("/api/auth/register")
                        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .content(objectMapper.writeValueAsString(req)))
                .andExpect(status().isCreated());

        LoginRequest login = new LoginRequest();
        login.setEmail("wrongpass@example.com");
        login.setPassword("incorrect");

        mockMvc.perform(post("/api/auth/login")
                        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .content(objectMapper.writeValueAsString(login)))
                .andExpect(status().isUnauthorized());
    }
}
```

### `backend/src/test/java/com/sportconnect/controller/EventControllerIntegrationTest.java`

```java
package com.sportconnect.controller;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.sportconnect.dto.auth.LoginRequest;
import com.sportconnect.dto.auth.LoginResponse;
import com.sportconnect.dto.auth.RegisterRequest;
import com.sportconnect.dto.event.EventCreateRequest;
import com.sportconnect.dto.event.EventDTO;
import com.sportconnect.dto.event.LocationDTO;
import com.sportconnect.model.SportType;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.autoconfigure.web.servlet.AutoConfigureMockMvc;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.test.context.DynamicPropertyRegistry;
import org.springframework.test.context.DynamicPropertySource;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.MockMvc;
import org.testcontainers.containers.MongoDBContainer;
import org.testcontainers.junit.jupiter.Container;
import org.testcontainers.junit.jupiter.Testcontainers;

import java.time.Instant;

import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.MockMvcRequestBuilders.*;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.result.MockMvcResultMatchers.*;

@Testcontainers
@SpringBootTest
@AutoConfigureMockMvc
class EventControllerIntegrationTest {

    @Container
    static MongoDBContainer mongo = new MongoDBContainer("mongo:6.0");

    @DynamicPropertySource
    static void mongoProps(DynamicPropertyRegistry registry) {
        registry.add("spring.data.mongodb.uri", mongo::getReplicaSetUrl);
    }

    @Autowired private MockMvc mockMvc;
    @Autowired private ObjectMapper objectMapper;

    private String registerAndLogin(String email) throws Exception {
        RegisterRequest reg = new RegisterRequest();
        reg.setEmail(email);
        reg.setPassword("password123");
        reg.setDisplayName("User " + email);

        mockMvc.perform(post("/api/auth/register")
                        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .content(objectMapper.writeValueAsString(reg)))
                .andExpect(status().isCreated());

        LoginRequest login = new LoginRequest();
        login.setEmail(email);
        login.setPassword("password123");

        String body = mockMvc.perform(post("/api/auth/login")
                        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .content(objectMapper.writeValueAsString(login)))
                .andExpect(status().isOk())
                .andReturn().getResponse().getContentAsString();

        return objectMapper.readValue(body, LoginResponse.class).getAccessToken();
    }

    private EventCreateRequest sampleEventRequest() {
        EventCreateRequest req = new EventCreateRequest();
        req.setSportType(SportType.FOOTBALL);
        req.setTitle("Friendly match");
        req.setDescription("Casual game");
        req.setLocation(new LocationDTO(48.8566, 2.3522));
        req.setAddressLabel("Parc des Princes");
        req.setStartTime(Instant.now().plusSeconds(3600));
        req.setDurationMinutes(60);
        req.setMaxParticipants(2);
        return req;
    }

    @Test
    void createEvent_withoutAuth_returns401() throws Exception {
        mockMvc.perform(post("/api/events")
                        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .content(objectMapper.writeValueAsString(sampleEventRequest())))
                .andExpect(status().isUnauthorized());
    }

    @Test
    void createEvent_thenListPublicly_returnsIt() throws Exception {
        String token = registerAndLogin("organizer1@example.com");

        String body = mockMvc.perform(post("/api/events")
                        .header("Authorization", "Bearer " + token)
                        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .content(objectMapper.writeValueAsString(sampleEventRequest())))
                .andExpect(status().isCreated())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.status").value("OPEN"))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.isOwnedByCurrentUser").value(true))
                .andReturn().getResponse().getContentAsString();

        EventDTO created = objectMapper.readValue(body, EventDTO.class);

        mockMvc.perform(get("/api/events"))
                .andExpect(status().isOk())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.items[?(@.id=='" + created.getId() + "')]").exists());
    }

    @Test
    void joinAndLeaveEvent_updatesParticipantCount() throws Exception {
        String organizerToken = registerAndLogin("organizer2@example.com");
        String participantToken = registerAndLogin("participant2@example.com");

        String body = mockMvc.perform(post("/api/events")
                        .header("Authorization", "Bearer " + organizerToken)
                        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .content(objectMapper.writeValueAsString(sampleEventRequest())))
                .andExpect(status().isCreated())
                .andReturn().getResponse().getContentAsString();
        String eventId = objectMapper.readValue(body, EventDTO.class).getId();

        mockMvc.perform(post("/api/events/" + eventId + "/join")
                        .header("Authorization", "Bearer " + participantToken))
                .andExpect(status().isOk())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.currentParticipants").value(1))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.isJoinedByCurrentUser").value(true));

        // joining twice should conflict
        mockMvc.perform(post("/api/events/" + eventId + "/join")
                        .header("Authorization", "Bearer " + participantToken))
                .andExpect(status().isConflict());

        mockMvc.perform(post("/api/events/" + eventId + "/leave")
                        .header("Authorization", "Bearer " + participantToken))
                .andExpect(status().isOk())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.currentParticipants").value(0));
    }

    @Test
    void updateEvent_byNonOwner_returns403() throws Exception {
        String organizerToken = registerAndLogin("organizer3@example.com");
        String intruderToken = registerAndLogin("intruder3@example.com");

        String body = mockMvc.perform(post("/api/events")
                        .header("Authorization", "Bearer " + organizerToken)
                        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .content(objectMapper.writeValueAsString(sampleEventRequest())))
                .andExpect(status().isCreated())
                .andReturn().getResponse().getContentAsString();
        String eventId = objectMapper.readValue(body, EventDTO.class).getId();

        EventCreateRequest update = sampleEventRequest();
        update.setTitle("Hacked title");

        mockMvc.perform(put("/api/events/" + eventId)
                        .header("Authorization", "Bearer " + intruderToken)
                        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .content(objectMapper.writeValueAsString(update)))
                .andExpect(status().isForbidden());
    }

    @Test
    void deleteEvent_byOwner_cancelsEvent() throws Exception {
        String organizerToken = registerAndLogin("organizer4@example.com");

        String body = mockMvc.perform(post("/api/events")
                        .header("Authorization", "Bearer " + organizerToken)
                        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .content(objectMapper.writeValueAsString(sampleEventRequest())))
                .andExpect(status().isCreated())
                .andReturn().getResponse().getContentAsString();
        String eventId = objectMapper.readValue(body, EventDTO.class).getId();

        mockMvc.perform(delete("/api/events/" + eventId)
                        .header("Authorization", "Bearer " + organizerToken))
                .andExpect(status().isNoContent());

        mockMvc.perform(get("/api/events/" + eventId))
                .andExpect(status().isOk())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.status").value("CANCELLED"));
    }
}
```

### `frontend/src/lib/apiClient.test.ts`

```ts
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, vi } from 'vitest';
import type { InternalAxiosRequestConfig } from 'axios';
import { apiClient } from './apiClient';
import { setToken, clearToken, getToken } from './tokenStore';

describe('apiClient request interceptor', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    localStorage.clear();
  });

  it('attaches Authorization header when a token is stored', () => {
    setToken('test-jwt-token');
    const handler = (apiClient.interceptors.request as any).handlers[0];
    const config = handler.fulfilled({ headers: {} } as InternalAxiosRequestConfig);
    expect(config.headers.Authorization).toBe('Bearer test-jwt-token');
  });

  it('does not attach Authorization header when no token is stored', () => {
    clearToken();
    const handler = (apiClient.interceptors.request as any).handlers[0];
    const config = handler.fulfilled({ headers: {} } as InternalAxiosRequestConfig);
    expect(config.headers.Authorization).toBeUndefined();
  });
});

describe('apiClient response interceptor', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    localStorage.clear();
    setToken('will-be-cleared');
  });

  it('clears the token and dispatches auth:unauthorized on a 401 response', async () => {
    const handler = (apiClient.interceptors.response as any).handlers[0];
    const listener = vi.fn();
    window.addEventListener('auth:unauthorized', listener);

    const fakeError = {
      response: { status: 401, data: { message: 'Unauthorized' } },
      message: 'Request failed with status code 401',
    };

    await expect(handler.rejected(fakeError)).rejects.toMatchObject({
      status: 401,
      message: 'Unauthorized',
    });

    expect(getToken()).toBeNull();
    expect(listener).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    window.removeEventListener('auth:unauthorized', listener);
  });

  it('normalizes network errors without a response body', async () => {
    const handler = (apiClient.interceptors.response as any).handlers[0];
    const fakeError = { message: 'Network Error' };

    await expect(handler.rejected(fakeError)).rejects.toMatchObject({
      status: 0,
      message: 'Network Error',
    });
  });

  it('passes through backend error message when present', async () => {
    const handler = (apiClient.interceptors.response as any).handlers[0];
    const fakeError = {
      response: { status: 409, data: { message: 'Email already exists' } },
    };

    await expect(handler.rejected(fakeError)).rejects.toMatchObject({
      message: 'Email already exists',
    });
  });
});
```

### `frontend/src/context/AuthContext.test.tsx`

```tsx
import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
import { AuthProvider, useAuth } from './AuthContext';
import { apiClient } from '../lib/apiClient';
import { getToken, getStoredUser } from '../lib/tokenStore';

vi.mock('../lib/apiClient', () => ({
  apiClient: { post: vi.fn() },
}));

function TestComponent() {
  const { user, isAuthenticated, login, logout } = useAuth();
  return (
    <div>
      <span data-testid="auth-state">{isAuthenticated ? 'in' : 'out'}</span>
      <span data-testid="user-name">{user?.displayName ?? 'none'}</span>
      <button onClick={() => login({ email: 'a@b.com', password: 'pw123456' })}>login</button>
      <button onClick={logout}>logout</button>
    </div>
  );
}

describe('AuthProvider', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    localStorage.clear();
    vi.clearAllMocks();
  });

  it('starts unauthenticated with no stored token', () => {
    render(
      <AuthProvider>
        <TestComponent />
      </AuthProvider>
    );
    expect(screen.getByTestId('auth-state')).toHaveTextContent('out');
  });

  it('login stores token/user and flips isAuthenticated', async () => {
    (apiClient.post as any).mockResolvedValueOnce({
      data: {
        accessToken: 'jwt-abc',
        expiresIn: 3600,
        user: { id: 'u1', email: 'a@b.com', displayName: 'Alice' },
      },
    });

    render(
      <AuthProvider>
        <TestComponent />
      </AuthProvider>
    );

    await userEvent.click(screen.getByText('login'));

    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByTestId('auth-state')).toHaveTextContent('in'));
    expect(screen.getByTestId('user-name')).toHaveTextContent('Alice');
    expect(getToken()).toBe('jwt-abc');
    expect(getStoredUser()).toMatchObject({ displayName: 'Alice' });
  });

  it('logout clears token/user', async () => {
    (apiClient.post as any).mockResolvedValueOnce({
      data: {
        accessToken: 'jwt-abc',
        expiresIn: 3600,
        user: { id: 'u1', email: 'a@b.com', displayName: 'Alice' },
      },
    });

    render(
      <AuthProvider>
        <TestComponent />
      </AuthProvider>
    );

    await userEvent.click(screen.getByText('login'));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByTestId('auth-state')).toHaveTextContent('in'));

    await userEvent.click(screen.getByText('logout'));

    expect(screen.getByTestId('auth-state')).toHaveTextContent('out');
    expect(getToken()).toBeNull();
  });

  it('reacts to a global auth:unauthorized event by logging out', async () => {
    (apiClient.post as any).mockResolvedValueOnce({
      data: {
        accessToken: 'jwt-abc',
        expiresIn: 3600,
        user: { id: 'u1', email: 'a@b.com', displayName: 'Alice' },
      },
    });

    render(
      <AuthProvider>
        <TestComponent />
      </AuthProvider>
    );

    await userEvent.click(screen.getByText('login'));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByTestId('auth-state')).toHaveTextContent('in'));

    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('auth:unauthorized'));

    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByTestId('auth-state')).toHaveTextContent('out'));
  });
});
```

### `frontend/src/components/layout/ProtectedRoute.test.tsx`

```tsx
import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
import { MemoryRouter, Route, Routes } from 'react-router-dom';
import { ProtectedRoute } from './ProtectedRoute';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext';

vi.mock('../../context/AuthContext', () => ({
  useAuth: vi.fn(),
}));

function renderWithAuth(isAuthenticated: boolean) {
  (useAuth as any).mockReturnValue({ isAuthenticated });

  return render(
    <MemoryRouter initialEntries={['/protected']}>
      <Routes>
        <Route path="/login" element={<div>Login Page</div>} />
        <Route element={<ProtectedRoute />}>
          <Route path="/protected" element={<div>Secret Content</div>} />
        </Route>
      </Routes>
    </MemoryRouter>
  );
}

describe('ProtectedRoute', () => {
  it('redirects to /login when not authenticated', () => {
    renderWithAuth(false);
    expect(screen.getByText('Login Page')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByText('Secret Content')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('renders the nested route when authenticated', () => {
    renderWithAuth(true);
    expect(screen.getByText('Secret Content')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});
```

### `frontend/src/components/events/EventForm.test.tsx`

```tsx
import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
import { EventForm } from './EventForm';

describe('EventForm', () => {
  it('shows a validation error and does not submit when title is empty', async () => {
    const onSubmit = vi.fn();
    render(<EventForm onSubmit={onSubmit} submitLabel="Create event" />);

    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/address/i), 'Somewhere');
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/start time/i), '2030-01-01T10:00');

    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /create event/i }));

    expect(await screen.findByRole('alert')).toHaveTextContent(/title is required/i);
    expect(onSubmit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('submits a well-formed payload when all required fields are valid', async () => {
    const onSubmit = vi.fn();
    render(<EventForm onSubmit={onSubmit} submitLabel="Create event" />);

    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/^title/i), 'Sunday football');
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/address/i), 'Central Park');
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/start time/i), '2030-01-01T10:00');

    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /create event/i }));

    await waitFor(() => expect(onSubmit).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));
    const payload = onSubmit.mock.calls[0][0];
    expect(payload.title).toBe('Sunday football');
    expect(payload.addressLabel).toBe('Central Park');
    expect(payload.sportType).toBe('FOOTBALL');
    expect(payload.startTime).toBe(new Date('2030-01-01T10:00').toISOString());
  });

  it('rejects an out-of-range latitude', async () => {
    const onSubmit = vi.fn();
    render(<EventForm onSubmit={onSubmit} submitLabel="Create event" />);

    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/^title/i), 'Bad location game');
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/address/i), 'Nowhere');
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/start time/i), '2030-01-01T10:00');

    const latInput = screen.getByLabelText(/latitude/i);
    await userEvent.clear(latInput);
    await userEvent.type(latInput, '999');

    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /create event/i }));

    expect(await screen.findByRole('alert')).toHaveTextContent(/latitude/i);
    expect(onSubmit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
```

## QA Test Report

### Scope
Automated unit + integration tests for the SportConnect MVP: authentication (register/login/JWT), event CRUD + join/leave lifecycle, geo-filtering guard rails, user profile updates, SSE notification fan-out logic, and the corresponding frontend auth/session handling, protected routing, and event form validation.

### Coverage Summary

| Area | Type | Status |
|---|---|---|
| JWT generation/parsing/expiry/tamper detection | Unit | ✅ Covered |
| Register/Login (success + all failure branches) | Unit + Integration | ✅ Covered |
| Event create/update/cancel ownership rules | Unit + Integration | ✅ Covered |
| Join/Leave lifecycle (open→full→open, conflicts, 404s) | Unit + Integration | ✅ Covered |
| Radius validation (`radiusKm <= 0`) | Unit | ✅ Covered |
| Notification fan-out targeting (new-game excludes organizer, roster/cancel hit organizer+participants) | Unit | ✅ Covered |
| User profile partial updates, organized/joined event mapping | Unit | ✅ Covered |
| Axios auth interceptor (attach token, 401 → logout + normalize errors) | Unit | ✅ Covered |
| AuthContext login/logout/global 401 reaction | Unit | ✅ Covered |
| ProtectedRoute redirect behavior | Unit | ✅ Covered |
| EventForm client-side validation & payload shape | Unit | ✅ Covered |
| EventCard rendering | Unit | ✅ Covered |

### Coverage Gaps & Risks (not exercised by this suite)

1. **Geospatial query correctness** — `EventService.listEvents` geo-filter (`$centerSphere`) is only unit-tested for the `radiusKm <= 0` guard; the actual `withinSphere` Mongo query against a real `2dsphere` index isn't verified end-to-end. Recommend a Testcontainers-based test seeding events at known coordinates and asserting radius inclusion/exclusion.
2. **SSE streaming (`SseEmitterRegistry`, `NotificationController`, `useNotifications`)** — Not covered. `SseEmitter`/`EventSource` are awkward to unit test; recommend a dedicated integration test using `MockMvc`'s async support for the backend, and a manual/E2E (Playwright/Cypress) check for the frontend reconnect/backoff logic and the `?access_token=` query-param auth path (flagged as an unconfirmed contract assumption in the frontend README).
3. **`ReminderScheduler`** — Untested. The 15-minute reminder window and `reminderSent` idempotency flag have no test coverage; a unit test mocking `EventRepository`/`NotificationService` and asserting `reminderSent` is set exactly once would close this gap.
4. **Rate limiting (`RateLimitingFilter`)** — Untested. No test asserts that the 11th `/api/auth/*` request within the window returns 429.
5. **`JwtAuthenticationFilter` fail-open behavior** — Not directly tested; behavior is indirectly exercised via the 401-on-missing-token integration tests, but a dedicated filter-level test (garbage token → anonymous context, not a hard failure) would increase confidence.
6. **Concurrency on join** — `EventService.joinEvent` reads-modifies-saves an `Event` document without optimistic locking (`@Version`). Under concurrent joins near capacity, this is a race condition that could over-fill an event. No test currently reproduces this; recommend adding a concurrent-threads integration test and considering optimistic locking or a MongoDB atomic `$push`-with-condition update.
7. **Frontend map rendering (`EventMap`, Leaflet)** — Not tested; `react-leaflet` requires real DOM layout (`getBoundingClientRect`) that jsdom doesn't fully support. Recommend a lightweight smoke test with mocked Leaflet internals, or defer to E2E.
8. **`useEvents`/`useUser` TanStack Query hooks** — Not directly unit-tested (only exercised transitively through component/integration tests). Recommend `renderHook` tests with a mocked `apiClient` to verify query key structure and cache invalidation on mutations (join/leave/update/delete).
9. **`useGeolocation`** — Not tested; geolocation permission-denied fallback path is unverified.
10. **CORS, Nginx SSE proxy config, Docker/Compose wiring** — Infrastructure, out of scope for automated tests; recommend a smoke test in CI (`docker compose up` + health check + one E2E flow).
11. **Password/email edge cases** — Bean Validation min/max lengths (e.g., password exactly 8 chars, displayName boundary lengths) aren't exhaustively parameterized; consider `@ParameterizedTest` sweeps for `RegisterRequest`/`EventCreateRequest` field boundaries.
12. **`EventForm` — numeric field edge cases** (duration below 15 min, maxParticipants = 1) are validated client-side but not exercised in tests beyond latitude; low risk since backend Bean Validation is the actual security boundary, but worth adding for UX completeness.

### Risk Assessment

- **High priority to close before scaling**: the join-event concurrency gap (#6) — this is a correctness bug risk under load, not just a test gap, since there's no `@Version` field on `Event`.
- **Medium priority**: SSE auth-via-query-param is an unconfirmed cross-team contract; until backend explicitly accepts `access_token` query param on the stream endpoint, notifications will silently fail in production despite passing all other tests.
- **Low priority**: map/geolocation UI gaps are best handled by a small E2E suite (Playwright) rather than unit tests, given jsdom/Leaflet friction.

### How to Run

```bash
# Backend (requires Docker for Testcontainers)
cd backend && mvn test

# Frontend
cd frontend && npm install && npm test
```
